That is the Aegean at its best - and at Paloma Pasha, it comes naturally. Set along a beautiful sandy bay in Özdere, İzmir, the resort blends effortlessly into its natural surroundings - with vibrant gardens, sweeping sea views and thoughtfully designed spaces that invite you to slow down. From elegant rooms overlooking the coast to swim-up options and spacious suites with private terraces, there’s a space for every way of unwinding. The pleasures extend to the table, where fresh local ingredients inspire a variety of dining experiences. And when you feel like exploring, the rich character and history of Izmir offer plenty to discover beyond the resort. At Paloma Pasha, mornings begin with the gentle rhythm of the sea, afternoons stretch lazily beneath the Aegean sun and evenings invite you to linger a little longer. With the comfort of Luxury Ultra All Inclusive hospitality, every detail is considered, leaving you free to enjoy the beauty of doing things at your own pace. Paloma Pasha. Come for the Sea. Stay for the Feeling. IN THE SPOTLIGHT BEACH During the day, for a more casual Aegean feel, look no further than Paloma Pasha where crystal-clear turquoise sea meets fine sandy beach. AMAZING LOCATION Paloma Pasha is located at Özdere in a spectacular bay. A perfect location for Aegean lovers. Wake up to the captivated nature scenery at the Aegean, where the days start with the touch of sunshine and freshness of the air. IDEAL FOR FAMILIES Paloma Pasha is a perfect place for families with its family rooms, special kids and teenage programs, activities for all ages and spectacular entertainment shows. Make every special moment count and create everlasting memories during your unforgettable family holiday. DISCOVER ROOMS Experience pure relaxation and supreme indulgence every moment or your stay with unmatched hospitality services and attention to even the smallest of details. Paloma Pasha offers 268 Rooms with sea and land view of standard rooms, suites and terrace suites. Reserve one of our effortlessly stylish rooms, each offering an elegant taste of Aegean. DISCOVER RESTAURANTS Culinary is our passion! Fill your heart and stomach with unforgettable culinary creations with us. Delicious dishes served elegantly just for you in an amazing atmosphere. Take a pleasure of an outstanding dining experience that will delight all of your senses. DISCOVER BARS From classic and creative cocktails to fresh brewed coffees and teas, discover a world of tempting bars at Paloma Pasha. DISCOVER BEACH & POOL Escape the where sea and beach views are endless. Get together with your family and friends. Sneak away to a comfortable sunbed where views over the sparkling sea make this a refreshing escape. Hang by the pool, indulge and light up. DISCOVER ACTIVITIES There’s something for every age, dream, and ability. Whether you are looking for enjoying day activities or adventurous water sports or building muscle, toning your body, and improve your athletic performance, our trainers will tailor the workout for you, making it fun while delivering the results you want. DISCOVER POLLY KIDS & TEENAGE CLUB Kids will have fun and learn at the same time with the activities and workshops held by the trained and experienced staff of the Polly Kids’ Club while teenagers will have a taste of freedom with our Teenage Club programs. Ignite their creativity and let them make new friends on a holiday they’ll never forget. DISCOVER SPA&WELLNESS WELLBEING Experience the Aegean beauty... Achieve complete balance in our SPA center, with progressive spa therapies, professional beauty treatments, and personalized fitness, just for you. DISCOVER PALOMA PASHA | ÖZDERE - İZMİR The Hotel is located in Izmir, Özdere city centre 1 km, Kuşadası 35 km, Izmir is 55 km, 50 km to the Adnan Menderes Airport. Directly on the private beach. A morning match on the tennis court, a new adventure on the water, a long lunch that nobody wants to end - the best days are made of moments shared and stories worth telling. Set across eight hectares of gardens beside the Mediterranean in Side, Orenda pairs clean-lined, low-rise architecture with the warm hospitality of Paloma. Its 350-metre sandy beach invites you to slow down, while sports facilities ranging from tennis and padel to archery and water sports offer plenty of ways to get moving. Palomaqua Side brings another dimension to the holiday, with 19 slides and splash attractions at one of the region’s most comprehensive water parks. Palomaqua is also Türkiye’s first resort water park to receive Safe Fun safety certification. Between adventures, fresh, flavourful dining and the generous choice of Ultra All Inclusive hospitality, Orenda always offers an option you can look forward to. Active when you want it to be, wonderfully relaxed when you don’t, Orenda makes room for every kind of holiday. Paloma Orenda. Made for More Together. IN THE SPOTLIGHT BEACH Paloma Orenda excites you with its spaceless 350m golden sand beach. Stretch out in your sun-lounger or beneath private, beachside cabanas, order your favourite beachy cocktail. TENNIS & CATAMARAN Paloma Orenda offers 10 quartz and 2 clay tennis courts for you to keep you fit and bring you joyful moments during your holiday and provides various Catamaran courses for beginners as well as advanced users. Professionals with licenses can explore the wide-open sea. NEW F&B CONCEPT Our culinary team is on an innovative mission to challenge your palate with food presentations made from locally sourced highest quality ingredients and created with impeccable techniques. Limitless fun for everyone Palomaqua! The largest and most diverse water park in the region, Palomaqua consists of 19 water slides and various water courses that surprises and entertains thrill-seekers of all ages. The color scheme of the water park is designed to highlight the water slides even more. DISCOVER ROOMS Touched by contemporary sleek style, filled with the natural colors of Mediterranean. Discover our divine collection of rooms at Paloma Orenda. DISCOVER RESTAURANTS We invite you to enjoy our restaurants, all of which have a unique ambiance. A delightful journey to our culinary heritage presenting traditional dishes with a twist of modern sophistication. DISCOVER BARS Paloma Orenda's bars highlights the best of local ingredients to create our own signature beverages and cocktails. DISCOVER BEACH & POOL Paloma Orenda excites you with its turquoise pools, golden sands and deep blue sea in a charming Mediterranean environment. Select your sun-lounger and lose yourself in a day of indulgent relaxation by the beach or pool. DISCOVER ACTIVITIES You can have fun while experiencing our perfectly personalised activities that will keep you captivated. Find the most exciting sport that will relax your body and mind at Paloma Orenda. DISCOVER POLLY KIDS & TEENAGE CLUB It is crucial that your children enjoy their vacation and have fun safely. The trained and experienced staff of the Polly Kids’ Club hold activities and workshops for the kids to have fun and learn at the same time. DISCOVER SPA & WELLNESS WELLBEING Achieve complete balance in our SPA center, with progressive spa therapies, professional beauty treatments and massages, just for you. Select the treatment of your choosing to relax physically, mentally and spiritually. DISCOVER PALOMA ORENDA | SIDE - ANTALYA PALOMA Orenda is located in Manavgat, Titreyengol, about 6 km from Side city center, 75 km from Antalya Airport and 80 km from Antalya city center. It has 270 rooms. PALOMA ORENDA (Belge No: 2224) Sorgun Mah. Acısu Mevkii Sk. Nestled on the stunning cliffs overlooking the azure blue Aegean Sea, our hotel offers an unparalleled retreat. Immerse yourself in opulent accommodations, each designed with meticulous attention to detail, providing a perfect blend of comfort and sophistication. Indulge in world-class dining at our diverse restaurants, offering a symphony of flavors inspired by global and local cuisines. Whether you're relaxing by the infinity pool, unwinding at the 5500 sqm Kempinski Wellness & Spa, or enjoying water sports on the private silent beach, every moment promises indulgence. Our attentive staff ensures impeccable service, creating an atmosphere of refined elegance. With the captivating beauty of Bodrum as your backdrop, Kempinski Hotel Barbaros Bay Bodrum invites you to experience a harmonious blend of luxury and natural splendor, making your stay a truly memorable escape.
